hero.subtitle: Bringing high quality groceries, fresh produce, and everyday household essentials directly to Portuguese families across 9 strategic supermarket locations.

about.paragraph1: King Supermarkets is the flagship retail arm of King Internationals, built on a foundation of quality, affordability, and community engagement. Our stores offer a warm, welcoming environment with an extensive selection of fresh fruits, vegetables, meats, bakery goods, and everyday household items.
about.paragraph2: We source directly from local farmers and trusted suppliers, ensuring farm-to-shelf freshness while keeping prices competitive for local families.
bulletPoints: Fresh daily deliveries from local Portuguese farms
Curated selection of national and international brands
Modern, clean, and accessible store layouts
Dedicated customer care team committed to excellence

items.title: Fresh Produce & Organic Goods
items.description: Daily harvested vegetables, seasonal fruits, and certified organic produce sourced directly from Portuguese growers.

items.title: Butchery & Fresh Bakery
items.description: Premium cuts of fresh meat, artisan bread baked in-store daily, and handcrafted traditional pastry selections.

items.title: Pantry & Groceries
items.description: Extensive selection of staples, oils, spices, beverages, and packaged goods from top European brands.

items.title: Household & Personal Care
items.description: Complete range of hygiene products, cleaning supplies, and home care essentials at value pricing.

items.title: Quality Guarantee
items.description: Strict quality checks on all incoming goods to guarantee maximum freshness and safety.

items.title: Competitive Pricing
items.description: Fair everyday pricing paired with frequent promotional offers and savings packages.

items.title: Convenient Locations
items.description: Strategically located stores with convenient parking and accessibility for local residents.

whoWeServe.titleLine1: Catering to the Unique Needs of

items.title: Local Families
items.description: Providing nutritious fresh foods and monthly pantry staples at prices that help manage household budgets.

items.title: Home Chefs & Bakers
items.description: Sourcing specialty ingredients, fresh herbs, and premium local meat and fish cuts for culinary lovers.

items.title: Health-Conscious Buyers
items.description: Offering certified bio, organic produce, gluten-free, and plant-based alternatives in every department.

featureHighlight.paragraph1: Our in-store bakeries operate around the clock to bring you traditional Portuguese bread, pastries, and croissants straight from the oven. We use only premium local grains and traditional sourdough fermenting methods.
featureHighlight.paragraph2: Smell the freshness the moment you walk through our doors, and enjoy crispy, warm bread made with clean, simple ingredients.

storeExperience.paragraph1: We organize our supermarkets with wide, well-lit aisles and clear department sections to minimize stress. Our friendly floor staff are always on hand to help you find items or carry heavy shopping to your car.
bulletPoints: Express checkouts and modern self-scan terminals
Ample parking with dedicated family spaces

items.question: What are the standard supermarket operating hours?
items.answer: Most of our King Supermarket locations are open 7 days a week from 8:00 AM to 9:00 PM.

items.question: Do you offer home delivery service?
items.answer: Yes, home delivery is available in select cities. Please contact your nearest store for details.

ctaBanner.subtitle: Experience fresh produce, great savings, and friendly community service.
